description: This file defines the TransactionFactory class, which models the <transaction-factory> XML element in the OFBiz entity configuration. It includes parsing logic for related JNDI configuration elements.

classes.name: TransactionFactory
classes.description: Models the <transaction-factory> XML element, providing access to its class name and nested JNDI configuration elements.

methods.name: TransactionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on an XML element, extracting class name and optional JNDI elements.

methods.name: getUserTransactionJndi
methods.description: Returns the UserTransactionJndi object or null.

methods.name: getTransactionManagerJndi
methods.description: Returns the TransactionManagerJndi object or null.
